rows.exact_behaviour_screen_workflow_inspecte: Transactional discharge resolves the patient, unassigns the current bed and persists the discharge encounter. Exact official loci: https://github.com/Bahmni/bahmni-core/blob/5dc6f25d7691dbeeb9924384704fc8e1616d77be/bahmnicore-omod/src/main/java/org/bahmni/module/bahmnicore/web/v1_0/controller/BahmniDischargeController.java#L18-L32
rows.strengths: Couples bed release and clinical discharge persistence in one declared transaction.
rows.limitations: No supported-living onboarding/exit checklist, Site authorization, handover, medication reconciliation or external rollback proof.
rows.neutral_requirements_extracted: Resolve the authoritative person; couple occupancy release to lifecycle transition; persist atomically; expose failure without split state.
rows.security_or_operational_caveat: The controller has no explicit privilege check and chooses the first bed service; caller authorization and service-selection safety remain unproved.
rows.reason_selected_or_excluded: Selected narrowly for a consequential client-record discharge transition.

rows.limitations: No Site scope, administrator competency, five-right checks, controlled-drug rules, stock effects, overrides or concurrent administration proof.

rows.exact_behaviour_screen_workflow_inspecte: Token-bound completion rejects expired, terminal, duplicate and out-of-order recipients, validates fields/2FA, transitions once transactionally and audits completion/authentication; rejection stores reason and audit evidence. Exact official loci: https://github.com/documenso/documenso/blob/962cffc9f546be68860be3489247f67255c83a66/packages/lib/server-only/document/complete-document-with-token.ts#L81-L179 | https://github.com/documenso/documenso/blob/962cffc9f546be68860be3489247f67255c83a66/packages/lib/server-only/document/complete-document-with-token.ts#L281-L369 | https://github.com/documenso/documenso/blob/962cffc9f546be68860be3489247f67255c83a66/packages/lib/server-only/document/reject-document-with-token.ts#L28-L112
rows.strengths: Signer-token binding, signing order, required fields, optional strong auth, concurrency guard and rejection/audit provenance.
rows.limitations: No NZ legal enforceability, certificate-chain trust, long-term validation, employment authority, delivery or Oblivion document/Site privacy proof.
rows.neutral_requirements_extracted: Bind document and signer; reject terminal/expired/out-of-order action; require fields/auth; transition once; retain request/reason evidence.
rows.security_or_operational_caveat: Sealing and email are asynchronous after transaction; monitor and recover their delivery.
rows.reason_selected_or_excluded: Selected for signer completion, rejection, audit and replay/concurrency integrity.

Exact official loci: https://github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma/blob/41ecaf17bdda1a16285dd1f164ba67ff7ad54fd3/server/model/monitor.js#L427-L480 | https://github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma/blob/41ecaf17bdda1a16285dd1f164ba67ff7ad54fd3/server/model/monitor.js#L927-L1059 | https://github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma/blob/41ecaf17bdda1a16285dd1f164ba67ff7ad54fd3/server/model/monitor.js#L1385-L1441 | https://github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma/blob/41ecaf17bdda1a16285dd1f164ba67ff7ad54fd3/server/model/maintenance.js#L391-L448

rows.limitations: Availability monitoring is not safety-signal provenance, custody, Site/client routing, durable outbox, acknowledgement or incident creation.

rows.reason_selected_or_excluded: Selected for monitoring/maintenance mechanics, not healthcare safety authority.
